contentItem.title: 直线图形：三边形、四边形和多边形
contentItem.englishTitle: Rectilineal figures are those which are contained by straight lines, trilateral figures being those contained by three, quadrilateral those contained by four, and multilateral those contained by more than four straight lines.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: Rectilineal figures are those which are contained by straight lines, trilateral figures being those contained by three, quadrilateral those contained by four, and multilateral those contained by more than four straight lines.
直线数字是直线数字,三边数字是三边数字,四边数字是四边数字,多边数字是四条以上直线。
